المرحلة_EN: Makkah: the beginning of revelation
الحدث: بدء الوحي في غار حراء
العنوان_EN: The beginning of revelation in the Cave of Hira
وجه_الارتباط: جاء جبريل عليه السلام إلى النبي ﷺ وهو يتعبد في غار حراء، فقال له: «اقرأ»، فنزلت الآيات الخمس الأولى من سورة العلق، وهي أول ما نزل من القرآن.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Jibril (peace be upon him) came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was worshipping in the Cave of Hira and said to him: “Read.” Then the first five verses of Surah al-Alaq were revealed. They are the first of the Quran to be revealed.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Aisha: ... An Angel came to him and asked him to read. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) replied, 'I do not know how to read.' ... he released me and said, 'Read, in the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists), has created man out of a clot, Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous. Who has taught (the writing) by the pen, has taught man that which he knew not.' (96.1-5).

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: the beginning of revelation
الحدث: فترة الوحي ثم نزول صدر سورة المدثر
العنوان_EN: The pause in revelation, then the opening of Surah al-Muddaththir
وجه_الارتباط: بعد فترة انقطع فيها الوحي، رأى النبي ﷺ الملك الذي جاءه بحراء جالسًا على كرسي بين السماء والأرض، فرجع إلى أهله فقال: «زمّلوني»، فدثّروه، فأنزل الله: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: After a period in which revelation had paused, the Prophet ﷺ saw the angel who had come to him at Hira, seated on a chair between the sky and the earth. He went back to his family and said: “Wrap me up,” and they covered him. Then Allah revealed: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Jabir bin 'Abdullah Al-Ansari (while talking about the period of pause in revelation) reporting the speech of the Prophet: "While I was walking, all of a sudden I heard a voice from the sky. I looked up and saw the same angel who had visited me at the cave of Hira' sitting on a chair between the sky and the earth. I got afraid of him and came back home and said, 'Wrap me (in blankets).' And then Allah revealed the following Holy Verses (of Quran): 'O you (i.e. Muhammad)! wrapped up in garments!' Arise and warn (the people against Allah's Punishment),... up to 'and desert the idols.' (74.1-5) After this the revelation started coming strongly, frequently and regularly."

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: the call, private and public
الحدث: إسلام سعد بن أبي وقاص وموقف أمه
العنوان_EN: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas's Islam and his mother's stance
وجه_الارتباط: حلفت أم سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه ألا تكلمه أبدًا ولا تأكل ولا تشرب حتى يكفر بدينه، فأنزل الله الوصية بالوالدين، مع النهي عن طاعتهما في الشرك، ومصاحبتهما في الدنيا بالمعروف.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The mother of Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (may Allah be pleased with him) swore never to speak to him, eat or drink until he renounced his religion. Allah then revealed the command to be good to parents, together with the command not to obey them in associating partners with Him, and to keep company with them in this world kindly.
نص_الحديث_EN: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that many verses of the Qur'an had been revealed in connection with him. His mother Umm Sa'd had taken oath that she would never talk with him until he abandoned his faith and she neither ate nor drank and said: Allah has commanded you to treat well your parents and I am your mother and I command you to do this. She passed three days in this state until she fainted because of extreme hunger and at that time her son whose name was Umara stood up and served her drink and she began to curse Sa'd that Allah, the Exalted and Glorions, revealed these verses of the Holy Qur'an:" And We have enjoined upon a person goodness to his parents but if they contend with thee to associate (others) with Me of which you have no knowledge, then obey them not" (xxix. 8) ; Treat thein with customary good in this world" (xxxi. 15). ...

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: the call, private and public
الحدث: النهي عن الجهر الشديد بالقراءة في الصلاة بمكة
العنوان_EN: Not raising the voice too loudly in prayer in Makkah
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: نزلت والنبي ﷺ مختفٍ بمكة، وكان إذا صلى بأصحابه رفع صوته بالقرآن، فإذا سمعه المشركون سبّوا القرآن ومن أنزله ومن جاء به، فأمره الله ألا يجهر بقراءته فيسمعها المشركون، ولا يخافت بها عن أصحابه.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: it was revealed while the Prophet ﷺ was in hiding in Makkah. When he led his Companions in prayer he would recite the Quran aloud, and when the polytheists heard it they insulted the Quran, the One who revealed it and the one who brought it. So Allah commanded him not to recite so loudly that the polytheists would hear, nor so quietly that his Companions could not.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: (regarding): 'Neither say your, prayer aloud, nor say it in a low tone.' (17.110) This Verse was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was hiding himself in Mecca. When he prayed with his companions, he used to raise his voice with the recitation of Qur'an, and if the pagans happened to hear him, they would abuse the Qur'an, the One who revealed it and the one who brought it. Therefore Allah said to His Prophet : 'Neither say your prayer aloud.' (17.110) i.e. do not recite aloud lest the pagans should hear you, but follow a way between.

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: the call, private and public
الحدث: الصدع بالدعوة على الصفا
العنوان_EN: Proclaiming the call from al-Safa
الراوي: عبد الله بن عباس / أبو هريرة
وجه_الارتباط: لما نزلت ﴿وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ﴾ صعد النبي ﷺ على الصفا، فجعل ينادي بطون قريش حتى اجتمعوا، فقال: «إني نذير لكم بين يدي عذاب شديد».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: When ﴿وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ﴾ was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ climbed al-Safa and called out to the clans of Quraysh one by one until they gathered. He said: “I am a warner to you, ahead of a severe punishment.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: When the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near-kindred, was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the Safa (mountain) and started calling, "O Bani Fihr! O Bani `Adi!" addressing various tribes of Quraish till they were assembled. Those who could not come themselves, sent their messengers to see what was there. Abu Lahab and other people from Quraish came and the Prophet (ﷺ) then said, "Suppose I told you that there is an (enemy) cavalry in the valley intending to attack you, would you believe me?" They said, "Yes, for we have not found you telling anything other than the truth." He then said, "I am a warner to you in face of a terrific punishment." Abu Lahab said (to the Prophet) "May your hands perish all this day. Is it for this purpose you have gathered us?" Then it was revealed: "Perish the hands of Abu Lahab (one of the Prophet's uncles), and perish he! His wealth and his children will not profit him...." (111.1-5)

الحدث: قول أبي لهب على الصفا ونزول سورة المسد
العنوان_EN: Abu Lahab's words at al-Safa and the revelation of Surah al-Masad
وجه_الارتباط: لما جمع النبي ﷺ قريشًا على الصفا وأنذرهم، قال أبو لهب: «تبًّا لك سائر اليوم، ألهذا جمعتنا؟»، فنزلت سورة المسد.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: When the Prophet ﷺ gathered Quraysh at al-Safa and warned them, Abu Lahab said: “May you perish for the rest of the day! Is this why you gathered us?” Then Surah al-Masad was revealed.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: When the Verse:--'And warn your tribe of near-kindred, was revealed, the Prophet (ﷺ) ascended the Safa (mountain) and started calling, "O Bani Fihr! They said, "Yes, for we have not found you telling anything other than the truth." He then said, "I am a warner to you in face of a terrific punishment." Abu Lahab said (to the Prophet) "May your hands perish all this day. Is it for this purpose you have gathered us?" المرحلة_EN: Makkah: persecution and disputes
الحدث: طلب المشركين إبعاد ضعفاء المسلمين عن مجلس النبي ﷺ
العنوان_EN: The polytheists ask that the weak Muslims be sent away from the Prophet's ﷺ gathering
وجه_الارتباط: قال سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه: كنا مع النبي ﷺ ستة نفر: أنا وابن مسعود ورجل من هذيل وبلال ورجلان، فقال المشركون: «اطرد هؤلاء لا يجترئون علينا»، فوقع في نفس النبي ﷺ ما شاء الله أن يقع، فأنزل الله: ﴿وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: we were six with the Prophet ﷺ: I, Ibn Mas'ud, a man from Hudhayl, Bilal and two other men. The polytheists said: “Send these away, so they do not grow bold against us.” Something of that entered the Prophet's ﷺ heart, as Allah willed, and Allah revealed: ﴿وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Sa'd reported: This verse was revealed in relation to six persons and I and Ibn Mas'ud were amongst them. The polytheists said to him (the Holy Prophet): Do not keep such persons near you. It was upon this that (this verse was revealed):" Drive not away those who call upon their Lord morning and evening desiring only His pleasure" (vi. 52).

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: persecution and disputes
الحدث: وعيد أبي جهل للنبي ﷺ وهو يصلي عند الكعبة
العنوان_EN: Abu Jahl threatens the Prophet ﷺ while he prays at the Kaaba
الراوي: أبو هريرة / عبد الله بن عباس
وجه_الارتباط: حلف أبو جهل لئن رأى النبي ﷺ يصلي عند الكعبة ليطأنّ على رقبته، فلما دنا منه نكص على عقبيه وقال: «إن بيني وبينه لخندقًا من نار وهولًا وأجنحة»، فقال النبي ﷺ: «لو دنا مني لاختطفته الملائكة». وفي رواية مسلم: فأنزل الله هذه الآيات.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abu Jahl swore that if he saw the Prophet ﷺ praying at the Kaaba he would tread on his neck. When he came near him, he turned back on his heels and said: “Between him and me is a trench of fire, terror and wings.” The Prophet ﷺ said: “Had he come near me, the angels would have snatched him away.” In Muslim's narration: then Allah revealed these verses.
نص_الحديث_EN: Abu Huraira reported that Abu Jahl asked (people) whether Muhammad placed his face (on the ground) in their presence. It was said to him: Yes. He said: By Lat and `Uzza. If I were to see him do that, I would trample his neck, or I would smear his face with dust. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was engaged in prayer and thought of trampling his neck (and the people say) that he came near him but turned upon his heels and tried to repulse something with his hands. It was said to him: What is the matter with you? He said: There is between me and him a ditch of fire and terror and wings. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: If he were to come near me the angels would have torn him to pieces. Then Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse ...

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: persecution and disputes
الحدث: قول أبي جهل: «اللهم إن كان هذا هو الحق من عندك»
العنوان_EN: Abu Jahl's words: "O Allah, if this is the truth from You"
وجه_الارتباط: قال أبو جهل: «اللهم إن كان هذا هو الحق من عندك فأمطر علينا حجارة من السماء أو ائتنا بعذاب أليم»، فنزلت الآيتان.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abu Jahl said: “O Allah, if this is indeed the truth from You, then rain down stones on us from the sky or bring us a painful punishment.” Then the two verses were revealed.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Anas bin Malik: Abu Jahl said, "O Allah! If this (Qur'an) is indeed the Truth from You, then rain down on us a shower of stones from the sky or bring on us a painful torment." So Allah revealed:-- "But Allah would not punish them while you were amongst them, nor He will punish them while they seek (Allah's) forgiveness..." (8.33) And why Allah should not punish them while they turn away (men) from Al-Masjid-al-Haram (the Sacred Mosque of Mecca)..." (8.33-34)

الحدث: دَين خبّاب عند العاص بن وائل
العنوان_EN: Khabbab's debt owed by al-As ibn Wa'il
وجه_الارتباط: كان لخبّاب بن الأرت رضي الله عنه دَين على العاص بن وائل، فأتاه يتقاضاه، فقال: «لا أعطيك حتى تكفر بمحمد»، فقال خبّاب: «لا أكفر حتى يميتك الله ثم تُبعث»، قال: «فدعني حتى أموت وأُبعث، فسأُوتى مالًا وولدًا فأقضيك»، فنزلت الآيات.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Khabbab ibn al-Aratt (may Allah be pleased with him) was owed a debt by al-As ibn Wa'il. He came to claim it, and al-As said: “I will not pay you until you disbelieve in Muhammad.” Khabbab said: “I will not disbelieve until Allah causes you to die and then raises you.” He said: “Then leave me until I die and am raised; I will be given wealth and children, and I will pay you then.” Then the verses were revealed.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Khabbab: I came to Al-`Asi bin Wail As-Sahmi and demanded something which he owed me. He said, "I will not give you (your money) till you disbelieve in Muhammad." I said, "No, I shall not disbelieve in Muhammad till you die and then be resurrected." He said, "Will I die and then be resurrected?" I said, 'Yes'. He said', "Then I will have wealth and children there, and I will pay you (there)." So this Verse was revealed:-- 'Have you then seen him who disbelieved in Our Signs and (yet) says: I shall certainly be given wealth and children? (19.77)

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: persecution and disputes
الحدث: حديث النفر الثلاثة عند الكعبة
العنوان_EN: The three men at the Kaaba
وجه_الارتباط: اجتمع عند الكعبة ثلاثة نفر: قرشيان وثقفي، أو ثقفيان وقرشي، فقال أحدهم: «أترون الله يسمع ما نقول؟»، فقال آخر: «يسمع إن جهرنا، ولا يسمع إن أخفينا»، فأنزل الله الآيات. وكان ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه مستترًا بأستار الكعبة يسمعهم.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Three men gathered at the Kaaba: two from Quraysh and one from Thaqif, or two from Thaqif and one from Quraysh. One of them said: “Do you think Allah hears what we say?” Another said: “He hears if we speak aloud, and does not hear if we speak quietly.” Then Allah revealed the verses. Ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him) was hidden behind the coverings of the Kaaba and heard them.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn Mas`ud: (regarding) the Verse: 'And you have not been screening against yourself lest your ears, and your eyes and your skins should testify against you..' (41.22) While two persons from Quraish and their brotherin-law from Thaqif (or two persons from Thaqif and their brother-in-law from Quraish) were in a house, they said to each other, "Do you think that Allah hears our talks?" Some said, "He hears a portion thereof" Others said, "If He can hear a portion of it, He can hear all of it." Then the following Verse was revealed: 'And you have not been screening against yourself lest your ears, and your eyes and your skins should testify against you...' (41.22)

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: persecution and disputes
الحدث: سؤال المشركين عن التوبة بعد القتل والزنا
العنوان_EN: The polytheists ask about repentance after killing and adultery
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: إن ناسًا من أهل الشرك قتلوا فأكثروا، وزنوا فأكثروا، فأتوا النبي ﷺ فقالوا: «إن الذي تقول وتدعو إليه لحسن، لو تخبرنا أن لما عملنا كفارة»، فنزلت آيات سورة الفرقان، ونزلت: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: some of the polytheists had killed much and committed fornication much. They came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “What you say and call to is good. If only you would tell us that there is an expiation for what we have done.” Then the verses of Surah al-Furqan were revealed, and also: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Some pagans who committed murders in great number and committed illegal sexual intercourse excessively, came to Muhammad and said, "O Muhammad! Whatever you say and invite people to, is good: but we wish if you could inform us whether we can make an expiration for our (past evil) deeds." So the Divine Verses came: 'Those who invoke not with Allah any other god, not kill such life as Allah has forbidden except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse.' (25.68) And there was also revealed:-- 'Say: O My slaves who have transgressed against their souls! Despair not of the Mercy of Allah.' (39.53)

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: the Year of Sorrow and Ta'if
الحدث: استماع الجن للقرآن بنخلة
العنوان_EN: The jinn listen to the Quran at Nakhlah
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: انطلق النبي ﷺ في طائفة من أصحابه عامدين إلى سوق عكاظ، فصلى بهم الفجر بنخلة، فاستمع نفر من الجن القرآن ورجعوا إلى قومهم، فأنزل الله على نبيه: ﴿قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: the Prophet ﷺ set out with a group of his Companions towards the market of Ukaz. He led them in the dawn prayer at Nakhlah, and a group of jinn listened to the Quran and returned to their people. Then Allah revealed to His Prophet: ﴿قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out along with a group of his companions towards `Ukaz Market. ... Those of the devils who had set out towards Tihama, went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Nakhla (a place between Mecca and Taif) while he was on his way to `Ukaz Market. (They met him) while he was offering the Fajr prayer with his companions. When they heard the Holy Qur'an being recited (by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)), they listened to it ... Then Allah revealed to His Prophet (Surat al-Jinn): 'Say: It has been revealed to me that a group (3 to 9) of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an).' (72.1) The statement of the Jinns was revealed to him .

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: the Year of Sorrow and Ta'if
الحدث: وفاة أبي طالب
العنوان_EN: The death of Abu Talib
وجه_الارتباط: حضر النبي ﷺ عمه أبا طالب عند موته، فقال: «يا عم، قل: لا إله إلا الله، كلمة أحاجّ لك بها عند الله»، فأبى، فقال النبي ﷺ: «لأستغفرن لك ما لم أُنه عنك»، فنزلت آية التوبة، ونزلت في أبي طالب: ﴿إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Prophet ﷺ came to his uncle Abu Talib as he was dying and said: “Uncle, say: There is no god but Allah, a word I can plead for you with before Allah.” He refused. The Prophet ﷺ said: “I will keep asking forgiveness for you as long as I am not forbidden.” Then the verse of Surah al-Tawbah was revealed, and about Abu Talib was revealed: ﴿إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Al-Musaiyab: When Abu Talib's death approached, the Prophet (ﷺ) went to him while Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abi Umaiya were present with him. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "O uncle, say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, so that I may argue for your case with it before Allah." On that, Abu Jahl and `Abdullah bin Abu Umaiya said, "O Abu Talib! Do you want to renounce `Abdul Muttalib's religion?" Then the Prophet said, "I will keep on asking (Allah for) forgiveness for you unless I am forbidden to do so." Then there was revealed:-- 'It is not fitting for the Prophet (ﷺ) and those who believe that they should invoke (Allah) for forgiveness for pagans even though they be of kin, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of the Fire.' (9.113)

المرحلة_EN: Makkah: time not specified
الحدث: احتباس الوحي ونزول سورة الضحى
العنوان_EN: Revelation is delayed, then Surah al-Duha is revealed
وجه_الارتباط: اشتكى النبي ﷺ فلم يقم ليلتين أو ثلاثًا، فجاءت امرأة فقالت: «يا محمد، إني لأرجو أن يكون شيطانك قد تركك»، فأنزل الله: ﴿وَالضُّحَىٰ ۝ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ ۝ مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ﴾. وفي رواية للبخاري (1125): احتبس جبريل عليه السلام، فقالت امرأة من قريش: «أبطأ عليه شيطانه».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Prophet ﷺ fell ill and did not rise for the night prayer for two or three nights. A woman came and said: “Muhammad, I hope your devil has left you.” Then Allah revealed: ﴿وَالضُّحَىٰ ۝ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ ۝ مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ﴾. In a narration in al-Bukhari (1125): Jibril (peace be upon him) was delayed, and a woman of Quraysh said: “His devil has been slow to come to him.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Jundub bin Sufyan: Once Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became sick and could not offer his night prayer (Tahajjud) for two or three nights. Then a lady (the wife of Abu Lahab) came and said, "O Muhammad! I think that your Satan has forsaken you, for I have not seen him with you for two or three nights!" On that Allah revealed: 'By the fore-noon, and by the night when it darkens, your Lord (O Muhammad) has neither forsaken you, nor hated you.' (93.1-3)

العنوان_EN: The believers reproached about humble hearts
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه: «ما كان بين إسلامنا وبين أن عاتبنا الله بهذه الآية إلا أربع سنين».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “Between our becoming Muslim and Allah reproaching us with this verse there were only four years.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Ibn Mas'ud said: Since our acceptance of Islam and the revelation of this verse in which Allah has shown annoyance to us:" Has not the time yet come for the believers that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah?" (lvii. 16), there was a gap of four years.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Hijrah and the founding years (1–2 AH)
الحدث: إسلام عبد الله بن سلام عند قدوم النبي ﷺ المدينة
العنوان_EN: Abdullah ibn Salam's Islam when the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Madinah
وجه_الارتباط: سأل عبد الله بن سلام رضي الله عنه النبيَّ ﷺ عن ثلاث مسائل لا يعلمهن إلا نبي، فقال النبي ﷺ: «أخبرني بهن جبريل آنفًا»، فقال ابن سلام: «ذاك عدو اليهود من الملائكة»، فقرأ النبي ﷺ: ﴿مَنْ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُ نَزَّلَهُ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abdullah ibn Salam (may Allah be pleased with him) asked the Prophet ﷺ about three matters that only a prophet would know. The Prophet ﷺ said: “Jibril has just told me about them.” Ibn Salam said: “That one is the enemy of the Jews among the angels.” The Prophet ﷺ recited: ﴿مَنْ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِجِبْرِيلَ فَإِنَّهُ نَزَّلَهُ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Anas: `Abdullah bin Salam heard the news of the arrival of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (at Medina) while he was on a farm collecting its fruits. So he came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "I will ask you about three things which nobody knows unless he be a prophet. ..." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Just now Gabriel has informed me about that." `Abdullah said, "Gabriel?" The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Yes." `Abdullah said, "He, among the angels is the enemy of the Jews." On that the Prophet (ﷺ) recited this Holy Verse:-- "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel (let him die in his fury!) for he has brought it (i.e. Qur'an) down to your heart by Allah's permission." (2.97) ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Hijrah and the founding years (1–2 AH)
الحدث: التوارث بالمؤاخاة ثم نسخه
العنوان_EN: Inheritance through the brotherhood, later abrogated
وجه_الارتباط: كان المهاجرون لما قدموا المدينة يرث المهاجريُّ الأنصاريَّ دون ذوي رحمه، للأخوّة التي آخى النبي ﷺ بينهم، فلما نزلت ﴿وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ﴾ نُسخ ذلك.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: When the Emigrants came to Madinah, an Emigrant would inherit from his Ansari brother instead of the Ansari's own relatives, because of the brotherhood the Prophet ﷺ had established between them. When ﴿وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ﴾ was revealed, that was abrogated.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Regarding the Verse: "To everyone, We have appointed heirs." (4.33) 'Mawali' means heirs. ... When the Emigrants came to Medina, an Emigrant used to be the heir of an Ansari with the exclusion of the latter's relatives, and that was because of the bond of brotherhood which the Prophet (ﷺ) had established between them (i.e. the Emigrants and the Ansar). So when the Verses:-- "To everyone We have appointed heirs." was revealed, (the inheritance through bond of brotherhood) was cancelled. ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Hijrah and the founding years (1–2 AH)
الحدث: تحويل القبلة إلى الكعبة
العنوان_EN: The change of the qiblah to the Kaaba
وجه_الارتباط: صلى النبي ﷺ نحو بيت المقدس ستة عشر أو سبعة عشر شهرًا، وكان يحب أن يوجَّه إلى الكعبة، فأنزل الله: ﴿قَدْ نَرَىٰ تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ﴾، فتوجّه نحو الكعبة. ونزل فيمن مات قبل التحويل: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Prophet ﷺ prayed towards Bayt al-Maqdis for sixteen or seventeen months, and he loved to be turned towards the Kaaba. Then Allah revealed: ﴿قَدْ نَرَىٰ تَقَلُّبَ وَجْهِكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ﴾, and he turned towards the Kaaba. About those who had died before the change was revealed: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Al-Bara: The Prophet (ﷺ) prayed facing Bait-ulMaqdis (i.e. Jerusalem) for sixteen or seventeen months but he wished that his Qibla would be the Ka`ba (at Mecca). (So Allah Revealed (2.144) ... Some men had died before the Qibla was changed towards the Ka`ba. They had been killed and we did not know what to say about them (i.e. whether their prayers towards Jerusalem were accepted or not). So Allah revealed:-- "And Allah would never make your faith (i.e. prayer) to be lost (i.e. your prayers offered (towards Jerusalem). Truly Allah is Full of Pity, Most Merciful towards mankind." (2.143)

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Hijrah and the founding years (1–2 AH)
الحدث: فرض صيام رمضان ونسخ التخيير
العنوان_EN: Fasting Ramadan made obligatory and the option abrogated
وجه_الارتباط: قال سلمة بن الأكوع رضي الله عنه: لما نزلت ﴿وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ﴾ كان من أراد أن يفطر ويفتدي فعل، حتى نزلت الآية التي بعدها فنسختها.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Salamah ibn al-Akwa' (may Allah be pleased with him) said: when ﴿وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ﴾ was revealed, whoever wished to break the fast and pay a ransom would do so, until the verse after it was revealed and abrogated it.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Salama: When the Divine Revelation: "For those who can fast, they had a choice either fast, or feed a poor for every day," (2.184) was revealed, it was permissible for one to give a ransom and give up fasting, till the Verse succeeding it was revealed and abrogated it.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Hijrah and the founding years (1–2 AH)
الحدث: قصة قيس بن صرمة ورخصة ليالي الصيام
العنوان_EN: Qays ibn Sirmah and the concession for the nights of fasting
وجه_الارتباط: كان الصائم إذا نام قبل أن يفطر لم يأكل حتى يمسي من الغد، وكان قيس بن صرمة الأنصاري رضي الله عنه صائمًا فنام قبل أن يطعم، فغُشي عليه نصف النهار، وكانوا لا يقربون النساء رمضان كله، فنزلت: ﴿أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: If someone fasting fell asleep before breaking his fast, he would not eat until the evening of the next day. Qays ibn Sirmah al-Ansari (may Allah be pleased with him) was fasting and fell asleep before eating, and he fainted at midday. They also did not approach their wives during the whole of Ramadan. Then this was revealed: ﴿أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Al-Bara: It was the custom among the companions of Muhammad that if any of them was fasting and the food was presented (for breaking his fast), but he slept before eating, he would not eat that night and the following day till sunset. Qais bin Sirma-al-Ansari was fasting and came to his wife at the time of Iftar (breaking one's fast) and asked her whether she had anything to eat. ... When it was midday on the following day, he fainted and the Prophet (ﷺ) was informed about the whole matter and the following verses were revealed: "You are permitted To go to your wives (for sexual relation) At the night of fasting." So, they were overjoyed by it. ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Hijrah and the founding years (1–2 AH)
الحدث: مرور النبي ﷺ بمجلس فيه عبد الله بن أبي قبل بدر
العنوان_EN: The Prophet ﷺ passes a gathering with Abdullah ibn Ubayy, before Badr
وجه_الارتباط: ركب النبي ﷺ حمارًا يعود سعد بن عبادة رضي الله عنه قبل وقعة بدر، فمرّ بمجلس فيه عبد الله بن أبي ابن سلول قبل أن يُظهر الإسلام، فآذاه بالقول. قال أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما: وكان النبي ﷺ وأصحابه يعفون عن المشركين وأهل الكتاب، ويصبرون على الأذى كما أمرهم الله، ثم ذكر الآية.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Before the Battle of Badr, the Prophet ﷺ rode a donkey to visit Sa'd ibn Ubadah (may Allah be pleased with him). He passed a gathering that included Abdullah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul, before he outwardly accepted Islam, and Ibn Ubayy insulted him. Usamah ibn Zayd (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions used to pardon the polytheists and the People of the Book and bear their harm patiently, as Allah had commanded them. Then he mentioned the verse.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Usama bin Zaid: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rode a donkey, ... He was going to pay visit to Sa`d bin Ubada in Banu Al-Harith bin Al-Khazraj; and this incident happened before the battle of Badr. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a gathering in which `Abdullah bin Ubai bin Salul was present, and that was before `Abdullah bin Ubai embraced Islam. ... So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) excused him, for the Prophet (ﷺ) and his companions used to forgive the pagans and the people of Scripture as Allah had ordered them, and they used to put up with their mischief with patience. Allah said: "And you shall certainly hear much that will grieve you from those who received the Scripture before you and from the pagans........'(3.186) ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Battle of Badr (2 AH)
الحدث: غنائم بدر وسؤال سعد عن السيف
العنوان_EN: The spoils of Badr and Sa'd's question about the sword
الراوي: عبد الله بن عباس / سعد بن أبي وقاص
الراوي_EN: Abdullah ibn Abbas / Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: «سورة الأنفال نزلت في بدر». وقال سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه: أصبت سيفًا فأتيت به النبي ﷺ فقلت: «نفّلنيه»، فقال: «ضعه»، فنزلت: ﴿يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: “Surah al-Anfal was revealed about Badr.” Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: I took a sword and brought it to the Prophet ﷺ and said: “Give it to me as extra spoils.” He said: “Put it down.” Then this was revealed: ﴿يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Sa`id bin Jubair: I asked Ibn `Abbas regarding Surat-al-Anfal. He said, "It was revealed in connection with the Battle of Badr."

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Battle of Badr (2 AH)
الحدث: استغاثة النبي ﷺ يوم بدر وأسرى بدر
العنوان_EN: The Prophet's ﷺ plea for help at Badr, and the captives of Badr
الراوي: عمر بن الخطاب (رواه عنه ابن عباس)
الراوي_EN: Umar ibn al-Khattab (narrated from him by Ibn Abbas)
وجه_الارتباط: قال عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه: لما كان يوم بدر نظر النبي ﷺ إلى المشركين وهم ألف، وأصحابه ثلاثمائة وتسعة عشر رجلًا، فاستقبل القبلة يدعو ربه، فأنزل الله: ﴿إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ﴾، فأمدّه الله بالملائكة. ولما أخذ الفداء من الأسرى أنزل الله: ﴿مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) said: on the day of Badr the Prophet ﷺ looked at the polytheists, who were a thousand, while his Companions were three hundred and nineteen men. He faced the qiblah and called on his Lord, and Allah revealed: ﴿إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ﴾, and Allah reinforced him with the angels. When he took ransom for the captives, Allah revealed: ﴿مَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Battle of Badr (2 AH)
الحدث: تخفيف مصابرة العدو
العنوان_EN: Lightening the duty to stand firm against the enemy
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: لما نزلت ﴿إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ﴾ شقّ ذلك على المسلمين حين فُرض ألا يفرّ واحد من عشرة، فجاء التخفيف في الآية التي بعدها.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: when ﴿إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ﴾ was revealed, it weighed on the Muslims, since it was made obligatory that one should not flee from ten. Then the easing came in the verse after it.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: When the Verse:-- "If there are twenty steadfast amongst you, they will overcome two hundred." (8.65) was revealed, then it became obligatory for the Muslims that one (Muslim) should not flee from ten (non-Muslims). ... Then there was revealed: 'But now Allah has lightened your (task)..' (8.66) So it became obligatory that one-hundred (Muslims) should not flee before two hundred (nonmuslims). ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Battle of Badr (2 AH)
الحدث: المبارزة يوم بدر
العنوان_EN: The duel at Badr
الراوي: أبو ذر الغفاري / علي بن أبي طالب
الراوي_EN: Abu Dharr al-Ghifari / Ali ibn Abi Talib
وجه_الارتباط: كان أبو ذر رضي الله عنه يُقسم أن هذه الآية نزلت في الذين تبارزوا يوم بدر: حمزة وعلي وعبيدة بن الحارث رضي الله عنهم، وعتبة وشيبة ابنا ربيعة والوليد بن عتبة.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abu Dharr (may Allah be pleased with him) used to swear that this verse was revealed about those who fought in single combat on the day of Badr: Hamzah, Ali and Ubaydah ibn al-Harith (may Allah be pleased with them), against Utbah and Shaybah, the sons of Rabi'ah, and al-Walid ibn Utbah.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Qais bin Ubad: Abu Dharr used to take an oath confirming that the Verse: 'These two opponents (believers, and disbelievers) dispute with each other about their Lord.' (22.19) was Revealed in connection with Hamza and his two companions and `Utbah and his two companions on the day when they ease out of the battle of Badr.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Battle of Badr (2 AH)
الحدث: القاعدون عن بدر وأولو الضرر
العنوان_EN: Those who stayed behind from Badr, and those with disabilities
الراوي: البراء بن عازب / زيد بن ثابت / عبد الله بن عباس
الراوي_EN: Al-Bara' ibn Azib / Zayd ibn Thabit / Abdullah ibn Abbas
روابط_التحقق: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:2831 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:2832 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4592 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4593 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4595 | https://sunnah.com/muslim:1898
وجه_الارتباط: لما نزلت ﴿لَا يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ دعا النبي ﷺ زيد بن ثابت رضي الله عنه فكتبها، فجاء ابن أم مكتوم رضي الله عنه فشكا ضرارته، فأنزل الله: ﴿غَيْرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ﴾. وقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: «القاعدون عن بدر، والخارجون إلى بدر».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: When ﴿لَا يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ called Zayd ibn Thabit (may Allah be pleased with him), who wrote it down. Ibn Umm Maktum (may Allah be pleased with him) came and complained of his blindness, and Allah revealed: ﴿غَيْرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ﴾. Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: “Those who stayed behind from Badr, and those who went out to Badr.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit: That the Prophet (ﷺ) dictated to him: "Not equal are those of the believers who sit (at home) and those who strive and fight in the Cause of Allah." Zaid added: Ibn Um Maktum came while the Prophet (ﷺ) was dictating to me and said, "O Allah's Apostle! By Allah, if I had the power to fight (in Allah's Cause), I would," and he was a blind man. So Allah revealed to his Apostle while his thigh was on my thigh, and his thigh became so heavy that I was afraid it might fracture my thigh. Then that state of the Prophet (ﷺ) passed and Allah revealed:-- "Except those who are disabled (by injury or are blind or lame etc).

الحدث: همّ بني سلمة وبني حارثة يوم أحد
العنوان_EN: Banu Salimah and Banu Harithah waver at Uhud
وجه_الارتباط: قال جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما: فينا نزلت ﴿إِذْ هَمَّتْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ تَفْشَلَا﴾: بنو سلمة وبنو حارثة، وما أحب أنها لم تنزل، لقول الله: ﴿وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: ﴿إِذْ هَمَّتْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ تَفْشَلَا﴾ was revealed about us, Banu Salimah and Banu Harithah. I would not wish it had not been revealed, because Allah says: ﴿وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Jabir: This Verse: "When two of your parties almost Decided to fall away..." was revealed in our connection, i.e. Bani Salama and Bani Haritha and I would not have liked that, if it was not revealed, for Allah said:-- But Allah was their Protector.....(3.122)

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Uhud and after (3–4 AH)
الحدث: جرح النبي ﷺ يوم أحد
العنوان_EN: The Prophet ﷺ is wounded at Uhud
الراوي: أنس بن مالك / عبد الله بن عمر
الراوي_EN: Anas ibn Malik / Abdullah ibn Umar
وجه_الارتباط: قال أنس رضي الله عنه: شُجّ النبي ﷺ يوم أحد وكُسرت رباعيته، فجعل يسلت الدم عنه ويقول: «كيف يفلح قوم شجّوا نبيهم؟»، فأنزل الله: ﴿لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ﴾. وفي البخاري عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أنها نزلت لما دعا النبي ﷺ في القنوت على رجال من المشركين.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: on the day of Uhud the Prophet ﷺ was wounded on the head and his front tooth was broken. He wiped the blood away, saying: “How can a people succeed who wounded their Prophet?” Then Allah revealed: ﴿لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ﴾. In al-Bukhari, Ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both) reports that it was revealed when the Prophet ﷺ supplicated in the qunut against some of the polytheists.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Salim's father: That he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), when raising his head from bowing of the last rak`a of the morning prayer, saying, "O Allah! Curse so-and-so and so-and-so" after he had said, "Allah hears him who sends his praises to Him. Our Lord, all the Praises are for you!" So Allah revealed:-- "Not for you (O Muhammad! )......(till the end of Verse) they are indeed wrong-doers." (3.128)

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Uhud and after (3–4 AH)
الحدث: اختلاف الصحابة فيمن رجع يوم أحد
العنوان_EN: The Companions differ over those who turned back at Uhud
وجه_الارتباط: قال زيد بن ثابت رضي الله عنه: لما خرج النبي ﷺ إلى أحد رجع ناس ممن خرج معه، فكان أصحاب النبي ﷺ فيهم فرقتين: فرقة تقول: نقاتلهم، وفرقة تقول: لا نقاتلهم، فنزلت: ﴿فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Zayd ibn Thabit (may Allah be pleased with him) said: when the Prophet ﷺ went out to Uhud, some of those who had set out with him turned back. The Prophet's ﷺ Companions were of two views about them: one group said, “We fight them,” and another said, “We do not fight them.” Then this was revealed: ﴿فَمَا لَكُمْ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِئَتَيْنِ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Zaid bin Thabit: When the Prophet (ﷺ) set out for (the battle of) Uhud, some of those who had gone out with him, returned. The companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) were divided into two groups. One group said, "We will fight them (i.e. the enemy)," and the other group said, "We will not fight them." So there came the Divine Revelation:-- '(O Muslims!) Then what is the matter within you that you are divided. Into two parties about the hypocrites? Allah has cast them back (to disbelief) Because of what they have earned.' (4.88) ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Uhud and after (3–4 AH)
الحدث: أنس بن النضر يوم أحد
العنوان_EN: Anas ibn al-Nadr at Uhud
وجه_الارتباط: وُجد بأنس بن النضر رضي الله عنه يوم أحد بضع وثمانون ضربة وطعنة ورمية، قال ابن أخيه أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه: «كنا نرى أن هذه الآية نزلت فيه وفي أشباهه».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Anas ibn al-Nadr (may Allah be pleased with him) was found on the day of Uhud with more than eighty sword blows, spear wounds and arrow wounds. His nephew Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “We used to think this verse was revealed about him and those like him.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Anas: My uncle Anas bin An-Nadr was absent from the Battle of Badr. He said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! I was absent from the first battle you fought against the pagans. (By Allah) if Allah gives me a chance to fight the pagans, no doubt. Allah will see how (bravely) I will fight." On the day of Uhud when the Muslims turned their backs and fled, he said, "O Allah! I apologize to You for what these (i.e. his companions) have done, and I denounce what these (i.e. the pagans) have done." ... We used to think that the following Verse was revealed concerning him and other men of his sort: "Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah.........." (33.23)

الحدث: قطع نخل بني النضير
العنوان_EN: Cutting the palm trees of Banu al-Nadir
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما: حرّق النبي ﷺ نخل بني النضير وقطع، وهي البويرة، فنزلت: ﴿مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَىٰ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: the Prophet ﷺ burned and cut down the palm trees of Banu al-Nadir at al-Buwayrah. Then this was revealed: ﴿مَا قَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ لِينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَىٰ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Umar: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the date-palm trees of Bani Al-Nadir burnt and cut down at a place called Al-Buwaira. Allah then revealed: "What you cut down of the date-palm trees (of the enemy) Or you left them standing on their stems. It was by Allah's Permission." (59.5)

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Uhud and after (3–4 AH)
الحدث: تحريم الخمر
العنوان_EN: The prohibition of wine
الراوي: أنس بن مالك / جابر بن عبد الله
الراوي_EN: Anas ibn Malik / Jabir ibn Abdullah
وجه_الارتباط: قال أنس رضي الله عنه: كنت ساقي القوم في منزل أبي طلحة، فنزل تحريم الخمر، فأمر النبي ﷺ مناديًا فنادى، فأُهريقت حتى جرت في سكك المدينة. فقال بعض القوم: «قُتل قوم وهي في بطونهم»، فأنزل الله: ﴿لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: I was serving drinks to the people in the house of Abu Talhah when the prohibition of wine was revealed. The Prophet ﷺ ordered a caller to announce it, and the wine was poured out until it flowed in the streets of Madinah. Some people said: “Some were killed while it was in their stomachs.” Then Allah revealed: ﴿لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Anas: I was the butler of the people in the house of Abu Talha, and in those days drinks were prepared from dates. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ordered somebody to announce that alcoholic drinks had been prohibited. Abu Talha ordered me to go out and spill the wine. I went out and spilled it, and it flowed in the streets of Medina. Some people said, "Some people were killed and wine was still in their stomachs." On that the Divine revelation came:-- "On those who believe And do good deeds There is no blame For what they ate (in the past)." (5.93)

العنوان_EN: Adoption abolished
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما: ما كنا ندعو زيد بن حارثة إلا «زيد بن محمد» حتى نزل القرآن: ﴿ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: we used to call Zayd ibn Harithah only “Zayd ibn Muhammad” until the Quran was revealed: ﴿ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Abdullah bin `Umar: We used not to call Zaid bin Haritha the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except Zaid bin Muhammad till the Qu'anic Verse was revealed: "Call them (adopted sons) by (the names of) their fathers. That is more than just in the Sight of Allah." (33.5)

الحدث: وليمة زواج أم المؤمنين زينب بنت جحش ونزول آية الحجاب
العنوان_EN: The wedding feast of Zaynab bint Jahsh, Mother of the Believers, and the verse of hijab
وجه_الارتباط: لما تزوج النبي ﷺ أم المؤمنين زينب بنت جحش رضي الله عنها دعا القوم فطعموا، ثم جلسوا يتحدثون، فلما قاموا بقي ثلاثة نفر، فاستحيا النبي ﷺ منهم، فأنزل الله آية الحجاب.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: When the Prophet ﷺ married the Mother of the Believers Zaynab bint Jahsh (may Allah be pleased with her), he invited people and they ate, then sat talking. When they got up, three men stayed behind, and the Prophet ﷺ was too shy to ask them to leave. Then Allah revealed the verse of the hijab.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Anas bin Malik: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) married Zainab bint Jahsh, he invited the people to a meal. They took the meal and remained sitting and talking. ... he got up, and the others too, got up except three persons who kept on sitting. ... Then Allah revealed: 'O you who believe! Do not enter the houses of the Prophet...' (33.53)

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Confederates and Banu al-Mustaliq (5 AH)
الحدث: قول عبد الله بن أبي في غزوة بني المصطلق
العنوان_EN: Abdullah ibn Ubayy's words during the campaign of Banu al-Mustaliq
روابط_التحقق: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4900 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4901 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4902 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4903 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4904 | https://sunnah.com/muslim:2772
وجه_الارتباط: سمع زيد بن أرقم رضي الله عنه عبد الله بن أبي يقول: «لا تنفقوا على من عند رسول الله حتى ينفضّوا، ولئن رجعنا إلى المدينة ليُخرجن الأعز منها الأذل»، فأخبر النبيَّ ﷺ، فحلف ابن أبي ما قال، فأنزل الله تصديق زيد.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Zayd ibn Arqam (may Allah be pleased with him) heard Abdullah ibn Ubayy say: “Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allah until they disperse. When we return to Madinah, the more honoured will surely drive out the more humble.” He told the Prophet ﷺ. Ibn Ubayy swore he had not said it, and Allah revealed what confirmed Zayd.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Zaid bin Arqam: While I was taking part in a Ghazwa. I heard `Abdullah bin Ubai (bin Abi Salul) saying. "Don't spend on those who are with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), that they may disperse and go away from him. If we return (to Medina), surely, the more honorable will expel the meaner amongst them." I reported that (saying) to my uncle or to `Umar who, in his turn, informed the Prophet (ﷺ) of it. ... So Allah revealed (the Sura beginning with) 'When the hypocrites come to you.' (63.1) The Prophet (ﷺ) then sent for me and recited it and said, "O Zaid! Allah confirmed your statement."

الحدث: انقطاع عقد أم المؤمنين عائشة ونزول آية التيمم
العنوان_EN: Aishah, Mother of the Believers, loses her necklace and the verse of tayammum is revealed
وجه_الارتباط: انقطع عقد لأم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها في بعض أسفار النبي ﷺ، فأقام الناس على التماسه وليسوا على ماء، فأنزل الله آية التيمم، فقال أسيد بن حضير رضي الله عنه: «ما هي بأول بركتكم يا آل أبي بكر».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: A necklace of the Mother of the Believers Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) was lost on one of the Prophet's ﷺ journeys. The people stayed to look for it, and they had no water. Then Allah revealed the verse of tayammum (dry ablution), and Usayd ibn Hudayr (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “This is not the first of your blessings, O family of Abu Bakr.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Aisha: The necklace of Asma' was lost, so the Prophet (ﷺ) sent some men to look for it. The time for the prayer became due and they had not performed ablution and could not find water, so they offered the prayer without ablution. Then Allah revealed (the Verse of Tayammum).

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Confederates and Banu al-Mustaliq (5 AH)
الحدث: حادثة الإفك وبراءة أم المؤمنين عائشة
العنوان_EN: The incident of the slander and the innocence of Aishah, Mother of the Believers
وجه_الارتباط: رُميت أم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها بالإفك، ومكث النبي ﷺ شهرًا لا يوحى إليه في شأنها، ثم أنزل الله براءتها في عشر آيات من سورة النور.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Mother of the Believers Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) was slandered in the incident of al-Ifk. For a month the Prophet ﷺ received no revelation about her. Then Allah revealed her innocence in ten verses of Surah al-Nur.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Aisha: ... So Allah revealed the ten Verses:- 'Verily! They who spread the slander Are a gang, among you.............' (24.11-20) ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Confederates and Banu al-Mustaliq (5 AH)
الحدث: يمين أبي بكر على مسطح
العنوان_EN: Abu Bakr's oath about Mistah
وجه_الارتباط: حلف أبو بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه ألا ينفق على مسطح بعد ما قال في عائشة رضي الله عنها، فأنزل الله: ﴿وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُو الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ﴾، فقال أبو بكر: «بلى والله، إني لأحب أن يغفر الله لي»، فأرجع إليه النفقة.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him) swore that he would no longer support Mistah after what he had said about Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her). Then Allah revealed: ﴿وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُو الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ﴾. Abu Bakr said: “Yes, by Allah, I love that Allah should forgive me,” and he resumed his support of him.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Aisha: ... Abu Bakr As-Siddiq ... said, 'By Allah, I will never provide for Mistah anything after what he has said about Aisha' ... So Allah revealed: 'Let not those among you who are good and are wealthy swear not to give (help) to their kinsmen ... Abu Bakr said, 'Yes, by Allah, I wish that Allah should forgive me.' So he resumed giving Mistah the aid he used to give him before ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: al-Hudaybiyah (6 AH)
الحدث: نزول سورة الفتح في الرجوع من الحديبية
العنوان_EN: Surah al-Fath revealed on the return from al-Hudaybiyah
الراوي: أنس بن مالك / عمر بن الخطاب
الراوي_EN: Anas ibn Malik / Umar ibn al-Khattab
روابط_التحقق: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4172 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4177 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4833 | https://sunnah.com/bukhari:4834 | https://sunnah.com/muslim:1785 | https://sunnah.com/muslim:1786
وجه_الارتباط: قال أنس رضي الله عنه: نزلت على النبي ﷺ مرجعه من الحديبية. وقال النبي ﷺ لعمر رضي الله عنه: «لقد أُنزلت عليّ الليلة سورة لهي أحب إليّ مما طلعت عليه الشمس».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: it was revealed to the Prophet ﷺ on his return from al-Hudaybiyah. The Prophet ﷺ said to Umar (may Allah be pleased with him): “Tonight a surah was revealed to me that is dearer to me than everything the sun rises upon.”

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: al-Hudaybiyah (6 AH)
الحدث: كفّ أيدي المشركين في الحديبية
العنوان_EN: The polytheists' hands held back at al-Hudaybiyah
وجه_الارتباط: قال أنس رضي الله عنه: هبط ثمانون رجلًا من أهل مكة من جبل التنعيم متسلحين، يريدون غِرّة النبي ﷺ وأصحابه، فأخذهم سِلمًا فاستحياهم، فأنزل الله: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: eighty armed men of Makkah came down from the mountain of al-Tan'im, seeking to take the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions by surprise. He captured them without fighting and spared their lives. Then Allah revealed: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that eighty Persons from the inhabitants of Mecca swooped down upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) from the mountain of Tan'im. They were armed and wanted to attack the Prophet (ﷺ) and his Companions unawares. He (the Holy Prophet) captured them but spared their lives. So, God, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed the verses: " It is He Who restrained your hands from them and their hands from you in the valley of Mecca after He had given you a victory over them."

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: al-Hudaybiyah (6 AH)
الحدث: فدية الأذى لكعب بن عجرة
العنوان_EN: The expiation for Ka'b ibn Ujrah's ailment
وجه_الارتباط: حُمل كعب بن عجرة رضي الله عنه إلى النبي ﷺ بالحديبية والقمل يتناثر على وجهه وهو محرم، فنزلت: ﴿فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ka'b ibn Ujrah (may Allah be pleased with him) was carried to the Prophet ﷺ at al-Hudaybiyah while in a state of consecration (ihram), with lice falling over his face. Then this was revealed: ﴿فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Abdullah bin Maqal: I sat with Ka`b bin Ujra in this mosque, i.e. Kufa Mosque, and asked him about the meaning of: "Pay a ransom (i.e. Fidya) of either fasting or . . . . (2.196)" He said, "I was taken to the Prophet (ﷺ) while lice were falling on my face. ... So the above Verse was revealed especially for me and generally for all of you."

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: al-Hudaybiyah (6 AH)
الحدث: امتحان المؤمنات المهاجرات
العنوان_EN: Testing the believing women who emigrated
الراوي: المسور بن مخرمة ومروان / عائشة أم المؤمنين
الراوي_EN: Al-Miswar ibn Makhramah and Marwan / Aishah, Mother of the Believers

وجه_الارتباط_EN: When the Prophet ﷺ was drawing up the treaty with Suhayl ibn Amr on the day of al-Hudaybiyah, believing women came as emigrants. Allah revealed the verse of examination about them, and the Prophet ﷺ would examine them by it.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Urwa: Aisha the wife of the Prophet, said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to examine the believing women who migrated to him in accordance with this Verse: 'O Prophet! When believing women come to you to take the oath of allegiance to you... Verily! Allah is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful.' (60.12) ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: al-Hudaybiyah (6 AH)
الحدث: بيعة الرضوان تحت الشجرة
العنوان_EN: The Pledge of al-Ridwan under the tree
وجه_الارتباط: قال جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما: قال لنا النبي ﷺ يوم الحديبية: «أنتم خير أهل الأرض»، وكنا ألفًا وأربعمائة، وبايعناه تحت الشجرة.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: on the day of al-Hudaybiyah the Prophet ﷺ said to us: “You are the best people on earth.” We were one thousand four hundred, and we pledged allegiance to him under the tree.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Jabir bin `Abdullah: On the day of Al-Hudaibiya, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to us' "You are the best people on the earth!" We were 1400 then. If I could see now, I would have shown you the place of the Tree (beneath which we gave the Pledge of Allegiance)." Salim said, "Our number was 1400."

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Conquest of Makkah and Hunayn (8 AH)
الحدث: كتاب حاطب بن أبي بلتعة إلى قريش
العنوان_EN: Hatib ibn Abi Balta'ah's letter to Quraysh
وجه_الارتباط: كتب حاطب بن أبي بلتعة رضي الله عنه إلى ناس من مشركي مكة يخبرهم ببعض أمر النبي ﷺ، فبعث النبي ﷺ عليًّا والزبير والمقداد رضي الله عنهم فأدركوا المرأة التي تحمل الكتاب بروضة خاخ وأخذوه، فنزلت: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Hatib ibn Abi Balta'ah (may Allah be pleased with him) wrote to some of the polytheists of Makkah, telling them about some of the Prophet's ﷺ plans. The Prophet ﷺ sent Ali, al-Zubayr and al-Miqdad (may Allah be pleased with them), and they caught up with the woman carrying the letter at Rawdat Khakh and took it. Then this was revealed: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Ali: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent me along with AzZubair and Al-Miqdad and said, "Proceed till you reach a place called Raudat-Khakh where there is a lady travelling in a howda on a camel. She has a letter. Take the letter from her." ... We brought the letter to the Prophet (ﷺ) and behold, it was addressed by Hatib bin Abi Balta'a to some pagans at Mecca, informing them of some of the affairs of the Prophet. ... (`Amr, a sub-narrator, said,: This Verse was revealed about him (Hatib): 'O you who believe! Take not My enemies and your enemies as friends or protectors.' (60.1)

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Conquest of Makkah and Hunayn (8 AH)
الحدث: يوم حنين وثبات النبي ﷺ
العنوان_EN: The day of Hunayn and the Prophet's ﷺ steadfastness
الراوي: البراء بن عازب / العباس بن عبد المطلب
الراوي_EN: Al-Bara' ibn Azib / Al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib
وجه_الارتباط: انكشف المسلمون يوم حنين أول الأمر، وثبت النبي ﷺ على بغلته يقول: «أنا النبي لا كذب، أنا ابن عبد المطلب»، ثم نصر الله المسلمين.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: At first the Muslims gave way on the day of Hunayn, while the Prophet ﷺ stood firm on his mule, saying: “I am the Prophet, no lie; I am the son of Abd al-Muttalib.” Then Allah gave the Muslims victory.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Abu 'Is-haq: I heard Al-Bara' narrating when a man came and said to him, "O Abu '`Umara! Did you flee on the day (of the battle) of Hunain?" Al-Bara' replied, "I testify that the Prophet (ﷺ) did not flee, but the hasty people hurried away and the people of Hawazin threw arrows at them. At that time, Abu Sufyan bin Al-Harith was holding the white mule of the Prophet (ﷺ) by the head, and the Prophet (ﷺ) was saying, "I am the Prophet (ﷺ) undoubtedly: I am the son of `Abdul-Muttalib."

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Tabuk and the Year of Delegations (9 AH)
الحدث: وفد بني تميم واختلاف أبي بكر وعمر
العنوان_EN: The delegation of Banu Tamim and Abu Bakr and Umar's disagreement
وجه_الارتباط: قدم ركب من بني تميم، فقال أبو بكر رضي الله عنه: «أمِّر القعقاع بن معبد»، وقال عمر رضي الله عنه: «بل أمِّر الأقرع بن حابس»، فتماريا حتى ارتفعت أصواتهما، فنزل في ذلك صدر سورة الحجرات.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: A delegation of Banu Tamim arrived. Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “Appoint al-Qa'qa' ibn Ma'bad as their leader,” and Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “No, appoint al-Aqra' ibn Habis.” They argued until their voices rose, and the opening of Surah al-Hujurat was revealed about that.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn Abi Mulaika: `Abdullah bin Az-Zubair said that a group of riders belonging to Banu Tamim came to the Prophet, Abu Bakr said (to the Prophet (ﷺ) ), "Appoint Al-Qa'qa bin Mabad bin Zurara as (their) ruler." `Umar said (to the Prophet). "No! But appoint Al-Aqra bin H`Abis." Thereupon Abu Bakr said (to `Umar). "You just wanted to oppose me." `Umar replied. "I did not want to oppose you." So both of them argued so much that their voices became louder, and then the following Divine Verses were revealed in that connection:-- "O you who believe ! Do not be forward in the presence of Allah and His Apostle..." (till the end of Verse)...(49.1)

الحدث: توبة الثلاثة الذين خُلّفوا
العنوان_EN: The repentance of the three who stayed behind
وجه_الارتباط: تاب الله على كعب بن مالك وهلال بن أمية ومرارة بن الربيع رضي الله عنهم، بعد خمسين ليلة هجرهم فيها المسلمون لتخلفهم عن غزوة تبوك.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Allah accepted the repentance of Ka'b ibn Malik, Hilal ibn Umayyah and Murarah ibn al-Rabi' (may Allah be pleased with them), after fifty nights in which the Muslims shunned them for staying behind from the expedition of Tabuk.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Abdullah bin Ka`b: I heard Ka`b bin Malik who was one of the three who were forgiven, saying ... The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade others to speak to me or to my two companions ... But Allah revealed His Forgiveness for us to the Prophet (ﷺ) in the last third of the night while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was with Um Salama. ... So when the Prophet (ﷺ) had offered the Fajr prayer, he announced Allah's Forgiveness for us. ...

الحدث: لمز المنافقين للمتصدقين
العنوان_EN: The hypocrites mock those giving charity
وجه_الارتباط: قال أبو مسعود الأنصاري رضي الله عنه: لما أُمرنا بالصدقة كنا نحامل على ظهورنا، فجاء رجل فتصدق بشيء كثير، فقال المنافقون: «مُراءٍ»، وجاء رجل فتصدق بصاع، فقالوا: «إن الله لغني عن صاع هذا»، فنزلت: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ الْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari (may Allah be pleased with him) said: when we were commanded to give charity, we would carry loads on our backs for hire. A man came and gave a large amount, and the hypocrites said: “A show-off.” Another man came and gave a sa', and they said: “Allah has no need of this man's sa'.” Then this was revealed: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ الْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Abu Mas`ud: When we were ordered to give alms, we began to work as porters (to earn something we could give in charity). Abu `Aqil came with one half of a Sa` (special measure for food grains) and another person brought more than he did. So the hypocrites said, "Allah is not in need of the alms of this (i.e. Abu `Aqil); and this other person did not give alms but for showing off." Then Allah revealed:-- 'Those who criticize such of the Believers who give charity voluntarily and those who could not find to give in charity except what is available to them.' (9.79)

الحدث: المسجد الذي أسس على التقوى
العنوان_EN: The mosque founded on piety
وجه_الارتباط: سأل أبو سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه النبي ﷺ عن المسجد الذي أُسس على التقوى، فأخذ كفًّا من حصباء فضرب به الأرض، ثم قال: «هو مسجدكم هذا»، يعني مسجد المدينة.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him) asked the Prophet ﷺ about the mosque founded on piety. He took a handful of pebbles, struck the ground with it, and said: “It is this mosque of yours,” meaning the mosque of Madinah.
نص_الحديث_EN: Abu Salama b. Abd al-Rabman reported: ... My father said: I went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was in the house of one of his wives, and said: Messenger of Allah, which of the two mosques is founded on piety? Thereupon he took a handful of pebbles and threw them on the ground and then said: This is the very mosque of yours (mosque at Medina). ...

الحدث: موت عبد الله بن أبي والصلاة عليه
العنوان_EN: The death of Abdullah ibn Ubayy and the prayer over him
الراوي: عبد الله بن عمر / عمر بن الخطاب
الراوي_EN: Abdullah ibn Umar / Umar ibn al-Khattab
وجه_الارتباط: لما توفي عبد الله بن أبي جاء ابنه إلى النبي ﷺ فأعطاه قميصه، وقام ليصلي عليه، فقال عمر رضي الله عنه: «أتصلي عليه وقد نهاك ربك؟»، فقال: «إنما خيّرني الله»، فصلى عليه، ثم أنزل الله: ﴿وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: When Abdullah ibn Ubayy died, his son came to the Prophet ﷺ, who gave him his shirt and stood to pray over him. Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “Will you pray over him when your Lord has forbidden you?” He said: “Allah has only given me a choice,” and he prayed over him. Then Allah revealed: ﴿وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا﴾.

الحدث: حجة أبي بكر والأذان ببراءة
العنوان_EN: Abu Bakr's Hajj and the announcement of Bara'ah
وجه_الارتباط: قال أبو هريرة رضي الله عنه: بعثني أبو بكر رضي الله عنه في الحجة التي أمّره عليها النبي ﷺ قبل حجة الوداع، في مؤذنين يؤذنون بمنى: «ألا لا يحج بعد العام مشرك، ولا يطوف بالبيت عريان»، ثم أردف النبي ﷺ بعليّ رضي الله عنه وأمره أن يؤذن ببراءة.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: in the Hajj that the Prophet ﷺ put Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) in charge of, before the Farewell Hajj, Abu Bakr sent me among the announcers who proclaimed at Mina: “After this year no polytheist may perform Hajj, and no one may circle the House naked.” Then the Prophet ﷺ sent Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) after him and ordered him to proclaim Bara'ah.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Humaid bin `Abdur-Rahman: Abu Huraira said, "During that Hajj (in which Abu Bakr was the chief of the pilgrims) Abu Bakr sent me along with announcers on the Day of Nahr ( 10th of Dhul-Hijja) in Mina to announce: "No pagans shall perform, Hajj after this year, and none shall perform the Tawaf around the Ka`ba in a naked state." Humaid bin `Abdur Rahman added: Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent `Ali bin Abi Talib (after Abu Bakr) and ordered him to recite aloud in public Surat Bara'a. ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: the Farewell Hajj and the last revelations (10–11 AH)
الحدث: يوم عرفة في حجة الوداع
العنوان_EN: The day of Arafah in the Farewell Hajj
وجه_الارتباط: قال رجل من اليهود لعمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه: «آية في كتابكم لو علينا معشر اليهود نزلت لاتخذنا ذلك اليوم عيدًا»، فقال عمر: «إني لأعلم حيث أُنزلت، وأيّ يوم أُنزلت: يوم عرفة، في يوم جمعة».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: A Jewish man said to Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him): “There is a verse in your Book which, had it been revealed to us Jews, we would have taken that day as a festival.” Umar said: “I know where it was revealed and on what day it was revealed: the day of Arafah, on a Friday.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Tariq bin Shibab: Some Jews said, "Had this Verse been revealed to us, we would have taken that day as `Id (festival)." `Umar said, "What Verse?" They said:-- "This day I have Perfected your religion for you, Completed My Favor upon you And have chosen for you Islam as your religion" (5.3) `Umar said, "I know the place where it was revealed; It was revealed while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was staying at `Arafat."

العنوان_EN: The last revealed: the verses on riba
الراوي: عائشة أم المؤمنين / عبد الله بن عباس
الراوي_EN: Aishah, Mother of the Believers / Abdullah ibn Abbas
وجه_الارتباط: قالت أم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها: لما نزلت الآيات من آخر سورة البقرة في الربا قرأها النبي ﷺ على الناس، ثم حرّم التجارة في الخمر. وقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: «آخر آية نزلت على النبي ﷺ آية الربا».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Mother of the Believers Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: when the verses at the end of Surah al-Baqarah about usury (riba) were revealed, the Prophet ﷺ recited them to the people, then forbade trade in wine. Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: “The last verse revealed to the Prophet ﷺ was the verse of usury (riba).”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Aisha: When the Verses of Surat-al-Baqara regarding usury (i.e. Riba) were revealed, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited them before the people and then he prohibited the trade of alcoholic liquors.

الحدث: تحرّج الأنصار من السعي بين الصفا والمروة
العنوان_EN: The Ansar's hesitation about walking between al-Safa and al-Marwah
وجه_الارتباط: قالت أم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها: كان الأنصار قبل أن يسلموا يُهلّون لمناة الطاغية، فكان من أهلّ لها يتحرّج أن يطوف بين الصفا والمروة، فلما أسلموا سألوا النبي ﷺ عن ذلك، فأنزل الله: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Mother of the Believers Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: before they became Muslim, the Ansar used to begin their pilgrimage in the name of Manat, the idol, and whoever did so felt it wrong to walk between al-Safa and al-Marwah. When they became Muslim they asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, and Allah revealed: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ﴾.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Urwa: ... `Aisha said, ... This Verse was revealed in connection with the Ansar who (during the Pre-Islamic Period) used to visit Manat (i.e. an idol) after assuming their Ihram, and it was situated near Qudaid (i.e. a place at Mecca), and they used to regard it sinful to ambulate between Safa and Marwa after embracing Islam. When Islam came, they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon Allah revealed:-- "Verily, Safa and Marwa (i.e. two mountains at Mecca) are among the Symbols of Allah. So it is not harmful of those who perform the Hajj of the House (of Allah) or perform the Umra, to ambulate (Tawaf) between them." (2.158)

الحدث: خصومة الأشعث بن قيس واليمين الكاذبة
العنوان_EN: Al-Ash'ath ibn Qays's dispute and the false oath
الراوي: عبد الله بن مسعود / الأشعث بن قيس
الراوي_EN: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud / Al-Ash'ath ibn Qays
وجه_الارتباط: قال النبي ﷺ: «من حلف على يمين يقتطع بها مال امرئ مسلم لقي الله وهو عليه غضبان»، فأنزل الله تصديق ذلك: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا﴾. قال الأشعث بن قيس رضي الله عنه: «فيّ نزلت، كانت بيني وبين رجل خصومة في بئر»، فقال له النبي ﷺ: «شاهداك أو يمينه».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever swears a false oath to take the wealth of a Muslim will meet Allah while He is angry with him.” Allah revealed confirmation of that: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَأَيْمَانِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا﴾. Al-Ash'ath ibn Qays (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “It was revealed about me. I had a dispute with a man over a well.” The Prophet ﷺ said to him: “Your two witnesses, or his oath.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Abu Wail: `Abdullah bin Masud said, "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Whoever takes an oath when asked to do so, in which he may deprive a Muslim of his property unlawfully, will meet Allah Who will be angry with him.' So Allah revealed in confirmation of this statement:--"Verily! Those who Purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter..." (3.77) Then entered Al-Ash'ath bin Qais ... Al-Ash'ath said, "This Verse was revealed in my connection. I had a well in the land of my cousin (and he denied my, possessing it). On that the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, 'Either you bring forward a proof or he (i.e. your cousin) takes an oath (to confirm his claim)' ...

الحدث: مرض جابر وآية الميراث
العنوان_EN: Jabir's illness and the verse of inheritance
وجه_الارتباط: قال جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما: عادني النبي ﷺ وأنا مريض لا أعقل، فتوضأ وصبّ عليّ من وضوئه فأفقت، فقلت: «يا رسول الله، كيف أصنع في مالي؟»، وفي رواية لمسلم: «إنما يرثني كلالة»، فنزلت آية الميراث.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: the Prophet ﷺ visited me while I was ill and unconscious. He made wudu' and poured some of its water on me, and I came to. I said: “Messenger of Allah, what should I do with my wealth?” In a narration of Muslim: “Only kalalah (childless and parentless relatives) will inherit from me.” Then the verse of inheritance was revealed.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Jabir: The Prophet (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr came on foot to pay me a visit (during my illness) at Banu Salama's (dwellings). The Prophet (ﷺ) found me unconscious, so he asked for water and performed the ablution from it and sprinkled some water over it. I came to my senses and said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! What do you order me to do as regards my wealth?" So there was revealed:-- "Allah commands you as regards your children's (inheritance):" (4.11)

الحدث: أرواح الشهداء
العنوان_EN: The souls of the martyrs
وجه_الارتباط: قال النبي ﷺ: «لما أُصيب إخوانكم بأحد جعل الله أرواحهم في أجواف طير خضر ترد أنهار الجنة»، فأنزل الله: ﴿وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا﴾. وفي صحيح مسلم أن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه سُئل عن الآية فقال: قد سألنا عن ذلك، فقال النبي ﷺ: «أرواحهم في جوف طير خضر لها قناديل معلقة بالعرش».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Prophet ﷺ said: “When your brothers were struck down at Uhud, Allah placed their souls inside green birds that come to the rivers of Paradise.” Then Allah revealed: ﴿وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَمْوَاتًا﴾. In Sahih Muslim, Ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him) was asked about the verse and said: we asked about that, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “Their souls are inside green birds that have lamps hanging from the Throne.”
نص_الحديث_EN: It has been narrated on the authority of Masruq Who said: We asked 'Abdullah about the Qur'anic verse:" Think not of those who are slain in Allah's way as dead. Nay, they are alive, finding their sustenance in the presence of their Lord.." (iii. 169). He said: We asked the meaning of the verse (from the Holy Prophet) who said: The souls, of the martyrs live in the bodies of green birds who have their nests in chandeliers hung from the throne of the Almighty. ...

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: time not specified
الحدث: الواهبات أنفسهن وإرجاء النبي ﷺ من يشاء
العنوان_EN: Women who offered themselves, and the Prophet ﷺ deferring whom he wished
وجه_الارتباط: قالت أم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها: كنت أغار على اللاتي وهبن أنفسهن للنبي ﷺ، فلما أنزل الله: ﴿تُرْجِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ﴾ قلت: «ما أرى ربك إلا يسارع في هواك»، أي: يعجّل لك ما تحب.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Mother of the Believers Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: I used to feel jealous of the women who offered themselves to the Prophet ﷺ. When Allah revealed ﴿تُرْجِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ﴾, I said: “I see your Lord hastens to fulfil your wishes,” meaning He quickly grants you what you love.
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Aisha: I used to look down upon those ladies who had given themselves to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I used to say, "Can a lady give herself (to a man)?" But when Allah revealed: "You (O Muhammad) can postpone (the turn of) whom you will of them (your wives), and you may receive any of them whom you will; and there is no blame on you if you invite one whose turn you have set aside (temporarily).' (33.51) I said (to the Prophet), "I feel that your Lord hastens in fulfilling your wishes and desires."

العنوان_EN: Hilal ibn Umayyah, Uwaymir al-Ajlani and the verses of li'an
الراوي: ابن عباس / سهل بن سعد / أنس بن مالك
الراوي_EN: Ibn Abbas / Sahl ibn Sa'd / Anas ibn Malik
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: قذف هلال بن أمية رضي الله عنه امرأته عند النبي ﷺ، فقال: «البيّنة أو حدٌّ في ظهرك»، فأنزل الله آيات اللعان. وفي حديث سهل بن سعد رضي الله عنه أن عويمرًا العجلاني سأل عن مثل ذلك، فقال النبي ﷺ: «قد أنزل الله فيك وفي صاحبتك».
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: Hilal ibn Umayyah (may Allah be pleased with him) accused his wife of adultery before the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “Proof, or the prescribed punishment on your back.” Then Allah revealed the verses of mutual swearing (li'an). In the hadith of Sahl ibn Sa'd (may Allah be pleased with him), Uwaymir al-Ajlani asked about a similar case, and the Prophet ﷺ said: “Allah has revealed something about you and your wife.”
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated Ibn `Abbas: Hilal bin Umaiya accused his wife of committing illegal sexual intercourse with Sharik bin Sahma' and filed the case before the Prophet. The Prophet (ﷺ) said (to Hilal), "Either you bring forth a proof (four witnesses) or you will receive the legal punishment (lashes) on your back." ... Then Gabriel came down and revealed to him:-- 'As for those who accuse their wives...' (24.6-9) ...

الحدث: قصة العسل ونزول صدر سورة التحريم
العنوان_EN: The honey incident and the opening of Surah al-Tahrim
الراوي: عائشة أم المؤمنين / عمر بن الخطاب
الراوي_EN: Aishah, Mother of the Believers / Umar ibn al-Khattab
وجه_الارتباط: قالت أم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها: كان النبي ﷺ يشرب عسلًا عند أم المؤمنين زينب بنت جحش رضي الله عنها ويمكث عندها، فاتفقتُ أنا وحفصة رضي الله عنها أن تقول له أيّتنا دخل عليها: «إني أجد منك ريح مغافير»، فقال: «بل شربت عسلًا، ولن أعود له»، فنزلت: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ﴾. وفي حديث عمر رضي الله عنه أن المرأتين المذكورتين في الآية الرابعة هما عائشة وحفصة رضي الله عنهما.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: The Mother of the Believers Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: the Prophet ﷺ used to drink honey at the house of the Mother of the Believers Zaynab bint Jahsh (may Allah be pleased with her) and stay with her. Hafsah (may Allah be pleased with her) and I agreed that whichever of us he came to would say to him: “I smell maghafir on you.” He said: “No, I drank honey, and I will not do it again.” Then this was revealed: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ﴾. In the hadith of Umar (may Allah be pleased with him), the two women mentioned in the fourth verse are Aishah and Hafsah (may Allah be pleased with them both).
نص_الحديث_EN: Narrated `Aisha: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to drink honey in the house of Zainab, the daughter of Jahsh, and would stay there with her. So Hafsa and I agreed secretly that, if he come to either of us, she would say to him. "It seems you have eaten Maghafir (a kind of bad-smelling resin), for I smell in you the smell of Maghafir," (We did so) and he replied. "No, but I was drinking honey in the house of Zainab, the daughter of Jahsh, and I shall never take it again. I have taken an oath as to that, and you should not tell anybody about it."

العنوان_EN: The polytheists object to fighting in the sacred month after the Nakhlah expedition
وجه_الارتباط: قال جندب بن عبد الله رضي الله عنه: بعث النبي ﷺ رهطًا أمّر عليهم عبد الله بن جحش رضي الله عنه، فلقوا ابن الحضرمي فقتلوه، ولم يدروا أكان ذلك اليوم من رجب أم من جمادى، فقال المشركون: «قتلتم في الشهر الحرام»، فأنزل الله: ﴿يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ قِتَالٍ فِيهِ﴾، فقال بعضهم: «إن لم يكونوا أصابوا وزرًا فليس لهم أجر»، فأنزل الله: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أُولَٰئِكَ يَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Jundub ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: the Prophet ﷺ sent out a small party under the command of Abdullah ibn Jahsh (may Allah be pleased with him). They met Ibn al-Hadrami and killed him, not knowing whether that day was in Rajab or Jumada. The polytheists said: “You killed in the sacred month.” Then Allah revealed: ﴿يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرَامِ قِتَالٍ فِيهِ﴾. Some of them said: “If they have not incurred sin, they have no reward either.” Then Allah revealed: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أُولَٰئِكَ يَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ﴾.

الحدث: أبناء الأنصار في بني النضير عند إجلائهم
العنوان_EN: Children of the Ansar among Banu al-Nadir at their expulsion
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: كانت المرأة من الأنصار قليلة الولد، تجعل على نفسها إن عاش لها ولد أن تهوّده، فلما أُجليت بنو النضير كان فيهم من أبناء الأنصار، فقالوا: «لا ندع أبناءنا»، فأنزل الله: ﴿لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: a woman of the Ansar who had few surviving children would vow that if a child of hers lived, she would raise him as a Jew. When Banu al-Nadir were expelled, there were sons of the Ansar among them, and they said: “We will not leave our sons.” Then Allah revealed: ﴿لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ﴾.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Uhud and after (3–4 AH)
الحدث: الاستجابة للخروج إلى حمراء الأسد بعد أحد
العنوان_EN: Answering the call to march to Hamra al-Asad after Uhud
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: لما انصرف المشركون عن أحد وبلغوا الروحاء، قالوا: «لا محمدًا قتلتم… بئس ما صنعتم، ارجعوا»، فبلغ ذلك النبي ﷺ فندب الناس، فانتدبوا حتى بلغوا حمراء الأسد، فأنزل الله: ﴿الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: when the polytheists left Uhud and reached al-Rawha', they said: “You did not kill Muhammad… what a bad thing you did. Go back.” This reached the Prophet ﷺ, and he called the people out. They responded and went as far as Hamra' al-Asad. Then Allah revealed: ﴿الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ﴾.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Uhud and after (3–4 AH)
الحدث: الخروج إلى موسم بدر في الموعد
العنوان_EN: Going out to Badr at the appointed season
وجه_الارتباط: قال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: كان أبو سفيان قال للنبي ﷺ: «موعدك موسم بدر»، فخرج المسلمون في الموعد فلم يجدوا بها أحدًا، وتسوّقوا، فأنزل الله: ﴿فَانْقَلَبُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: Abu Sufyan had said to the Prophet ﷺ: “Our appointment is the season of Badr.” The Muslims went out at the appointed time and found no one there, so they traded in the market. Then Allah revealed: ﴿فَانْقَلَبُوا بِنِعْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَضْلٍ لَمْ يَمْسَسْهُمْ سُوءٌ﴾.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Tabuk and the Year of Delegations (9 AH)
الحدث: صلاة النبي ﷺ على النجاشي
العنوان_EN: The Prophet ﷺ prays the funeral prayer for the Negus
وجه_الارتباط: قال أنس رضي الله عنه: لما جاء نعي النجاشي قال النبي ﷺ: «صلّوا عليه»، فقالوا: «نصلي على عبد حبشي؟»، فأنزل الله: ﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ﴾.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: when news came of the death of the Negus, the Prophet ﷺ said: “Pray for him.” They said: “Shall we pray for an Abyssinian slave?” Then Allah revealed: ﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ﴾.

المرحلة_EN: Madinah: Uhud and after (3–4 AH)
الحدث: ابنتا سعد بن الربيع بعد استشهاد أبيهما في أحد
العنوان_EN: The two daughters of Sa'd ibn al-Rabi' after their father was martyred at Uhud
وجه_الارتباط: قال جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما: جاءت امرأة سعد بن الربيع رضي الله عنه بابنتيها فقالت: «يا رسول الله، هاتان ابنتا سعد بن الربيع، قُتل أبوهما معك في أحد شهيدًا، وإن عمهما أخذ مالهما»، فنزلت آية الميراث، فأمر النبي ﷺ عمهما أن يعطيهما الثلثين، وأمهما الثمن.
وجه_الارتباط_EN: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: the wife of Sa'd ibn al-Rabi' (may Allah be pleased with him) came with her two daughters and said: “Messenger of Allah, these are the two daughters of Sa'd ibn al-Rabi'. Their father was killed as a martyr with you at Uhud, and their uncle has taken their wealth.” Then the verse of inheritance was revealed, and the Prophet ﷺ ordered their uncle to give them two thirds and their mother one eighth.
